en.title: Seven-Seat SUV Procurement for Latin America: Load, Restraints and Admission
en.seo_title: Seven-Seat SUV for Latin America: Restraints, Legal Load and Model Approval
en.meta_description: Test whether a specific seven-seat SUV derivative carries planned adults and luggage within legal load: Latin NCAP 2026-2029 rear-seat (not automatically third-row) assessment, Argentina LCM model approval and Brazil LOTACAO. No OEM exact seven-seat derivative was captured, so no model is recommended.
en.summary: A seven-seat badge is a seating count, not a load case. This page separates the load test (Brazil LOTACAO), model approval for the exact derivative (Argentina LCM/LCA) and restraint inventory from OEM data; rear-seat assessment is not third-row assessment, and no seven-seat purchase conclusion is drawn without an OEM exact-derivative primary.
en.method: Document research and a load/restraint/admission verification framework built on the Latin NCAP 2026-2029 protocol update, Argentina's LCM route and Brazil's LOTACAO definition.
en.ai_disclosure: Prepared by the AutoBridge Export Editorial Team with AI assistance for source organization, drafting, revision and translation. This is AI-assisted independent review, not human editorial sign-off; final editorial review is pending.
en.evidence_boundary: No first-hand test, purchase or homologation is claimed. No OEM exact seven-seat derivative primary (third-row belts and head restraints, kerb/GVW, payload, seven-seat luggage volume) was captured; rear-seat assessment is not treated as third-row assessment; Chile, Colombia, Peru and Mexico homologation remains open.

zh.title: 七座 SUV 出口拉美采购：载荷、约束装置与准入
zh.seo_title: 拉美七座 SUV：约束装置、法定载荷与车型批准
zh.meta_description: 检验具体七座衍生车型能否在法定载荷内承载计划中的成人与行李：Latin NCAP 2026-2029 后排（不自动等于第三排）评估、阿根廷 LCM 车型批准与巴西 LOTACAO。未采集到 OEM 确切七座衍生车型一手文件，故不推荐车型。
zh.summary: 七座标识是座位计数，不是载荷工况。本页把载荷检验（巴西 LOTACAO）、依附确切衍生车型的车型批准（阿根廷 LCM/LCA）与须取自 OEM 数据的约束装置清单分开；后排评估不等于第三排评估，缺 OEM 确切衍生车型一手文件时不下七座采购结论。
zh.method: 基于 Latin NCAP 2026-2029 规程更新、阿根廷 LCM 路径与巴西 LOTACAO 定义的文献研究与载荷/约束装置/准入核验框架。
zh.ai_disclosure: 由 AutoBridge Export Editorial Team 编写，AI 协助完成来源整理、起草、修订与翻译。这是 AI 辅助的独立审阅，并非人工编辑签发，最终编辑审阅仍在进行中。
zh.evidence_boundary: 本页不主张任何一手测试、采购或 homologation 经历；未采集到 OEM 确切七座衍生车型一手文件（第三排安全带与头枕、整备/总质量、有效载荷、七座行李厢容积）；不把后排评估当作第三排评估；智利、哥伦比亚、秘鲁、墨西哥准入仍为开放项。
